name: Hemlo Mining Corp.
summary: Hemlo Mining Corp. engages in the production and operation of gold mining assets in Canada. Its flagship asset is the 100% owned Hemlo gold mine covering approximately 45,000 hectares located at Marathon in northwestern Ontario, Canada. The company was formerly known as Carcetti Capital Corp. and changed its name to Hemlo Mining Corp. in November 2025. The company was incorporated in 2025 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
